ORDINANCE V OF 1991
ORDINANCE V OF 1991
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE (PAYMENT OF DEARNESS ALLOWANCE TO CERTAIN
EMPLOYEES) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1991
An Ordinance to amend the
North-West Frontier Province (Payment of Dearness Allowance to Certain
Employees) Act, 1991
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 30th April, 1991]
No. Legis./1(2)/90/2159, dated
30-4-1991.---The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West Frontier
Province is hereby published for general information.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the North-West Frontier Province (Payment of Dearness Allowance to Certain
Employees) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1991.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 26th day of March, 1991.
